_comment: OSM extracts the cloud builder may use (docs/design/map-hosting.md §Source data). A cell is built only when its exact bbox lies inside one 'cover' rectangle of a source ([west, south, east, north], conservative: well inside the extract's real border). The doorman (Worker) uses the same file to answer 'Source data not available for this area yet' without starting a build. Add an extract = add an entry + push (deploys to test). Later: choose Geofabrik leaf extracts automatically (tools/hetzner/server/onpath_maps/sources.py).
